description: Interface direction: distinctive UI, palette, type, layout, motion. sk-design interface mode.

userIntent.job: I want to invent or reshape a distinctive interface direction for a surface.

accepts: an interface target plus an optional mode hint for direction, redesign, or build judgment
returns: a deliberate interface direction with rationale, visual choices, critique, and handoff notes

examples.returnsArtifact: a deliberate interface direction with rationale, visual choices, critique, and handoff notes

choreography.action: load the parent hub routing table and shared references

choose at most one private procedure card (discovery-question-round.md for missing material brief facts, aesthetic-direction.md for greenfield direction without a stronger brand/system, wireframe-exploration.md for low-fidelity structure or storyboard, variation-set.md for multiple high-fidelity directions or alternatives, prototype-flow-spec.md for prototype/demo/stateful interaction briefs, deck-direction-spec.md for slide deck or presentation design) matching the request, or ../shared/procedures/polish-gate-orchestration.md for final polish spanning multiple design dimensions; cite the selected card's relative path in the plan or proof line, or state 'Procedure applied: none - baseline interface workflow' if no card matches
load mode references and assets as the work requires, then apply the interface workflow to $ARGUMENTS
prepare implementation handoff only when accepted design output moves to code

nextOptions.when: the direction needs purposeful animation, transitions, or micro-interactions

handoff.handoffReason: recommend-only; the user or the sk-design hub chooses the next step, never an automatic chain

tasks.label: direction
tasks.surface: default --mode: invent a distinctive interface direction

tasks.label: preflight
tasks.surface: --mode preflight: run the pre-ship mechanical gate

tasks.label: quality
tasks.surface: quality floor and mechanical preflight checks inside the workflow

tasks.label: visual-system
tasks.surface: static visual system inside the workflow: color, type, spacing, tokens, theming

tasks.label: handoff
tasks.surface: --mode build: real UI loop and sk-code handoff manifest

tasks.label: register
tasks.surface: always-load register calibration dial; not a chooser

tasks.label: copy-gate
tasks.surface: content delivery gate inside the workflow

tasks.label: transform
tasks.surface: make-frame transform verb (bolder/quieter/distill/clarify/delight) already routed here; taskProjections below carries the explicit verb argument

tasks.label: reference
tasks.surface: real-world reference critique tooling; not surfaced to the caller

taskProjections.requires: an interface surface to push louder
an interface surface to reduce to essentials
an interface surface to add an earned moment to

registerPolicy.askWhen: the register cannot be resolved from the flag, a declared field, the task cue, or the surface, or the surface is genuinely mixed across Brand and Product so the dials would diverge

deferToHubWhen: the request is primarily motion behavior or measured CSS extraction

preconditions.requiredInputKind: an interface target (surface, screen, or component set) plus the register and any mode hint
preconditions.missingInputQuestion: Which interface surface, and is this Brand or Product register?
preconditions.cannotRunWhen: no interface target is named to shape
preconditions.escalateIf: the register is genuinely mixed or unresolved and changes the design dials
preconditions.routeInstead: the request is primarily motion behavior or measured CSS extraction

discriminator.whenToUse: Use this command when the request is to invent or reshape a distinctive interface direction.

preferSiblingWhen.when: Prefer md-generator when the request is extracting a live site's measured CSS into DESIGN.md.
Prefer motion when the request is animation choreography, transitions, micro-interactions, or reduced-motion behavior.

preferSiblingWhen.sibling: design-mcp-open-design (no standalone command; reached via the sk-design hub paired with a design mode)
preferSiblingWhen.when: Prefer design-mcp-open-design when the request is to wire, read, or drive Open Design's MCP server rather than invent a new interface direction.

discriminator.pairWithHubWhen: the request is primarily motion behavior or measured CSS extraction

description: Style Reference DESIGN.md extraction: live CSS and measured tokens. sk-design md-generator mode.

userIntent.job: I want to extract a live site's real measured CSS into a Style Reference DESIGN.md.

accepts: a reachable live URL plus an output directory
returns: a Style Reference DESIGN.md and extracted token data under the output directory

examples.returnsArtifact: a Style Reference DESIGN.md and extracted token data under the output directory

choreography.action: load the parent hub routing table and shared references

select the private design-system-extraction.md card when the request involves measured extraction, token capture, CSS capture, DESIGN.md generation, source design systems, screenshots, brand references, gaps, inconsistencies, or grounding future work in an existing surface; cite the selected card's relative path in the plan or proof line, or state 'Procedure applied: none - baseline md-generator pipeline' if the card does not match
load mode references and assets as the work requires, then apply the md-generator workflow to $ARGUMENTS
prepare implementation handoff only when accepted design output moves to code

nextOptions.when: measured evidence should inform a new or reshaped interface direction

handoff.handoffReason: recommend-only; the user or the sk-design hub chooses the next step, never an automatic chain

registerPolicy.askWhen: the register cannot be resolved from the flag, a declared field, the task cue, or the surface, or the surface is genuinely mixed across Brand and Product so the dials would diverge

deferToHubWhen: the request spans more than measured CSS extraction, such as redesign, critique, or new visual-system invention

preconditions.requiredInputKind: a reachable live URL plus a writable output directory
preconditions.missingInputQuestion: Which live URL should I extract, and where should the DESIGN.md be written?
preconditions.cannotRunWhen: the URL is missing or unreachable, or the output directory cannot be resolved or written
preconditions.escalateIf: the site requires authentication or blocks headless extraction so the CSS cannot be captured
preconditions.routeInstead: the request spans redesign, critique, or new visual-system invention rather than measured extraction

discriminator.whenToUse: Use this command when the request is to extract a live site's real measured CSS into DESIGN.md.

preferSiblingWhen.when: Prefer interface when the request is to invent a new design direction instead of capturing what already exists.
Prefer motion when the request is to design animation, transitions, or micro-interaction behavior.

preferSiblingWhen.sibling: design-mcp-open-design (no standalone command; reached via the sk-design hub paired with a design mode)
preferSiblingWhen.when: Prefer design-mcp-open-design when the request is to wire, read, or drive Open Design's MCP server rather than extract measured CSS from a live website.

discriminator.pairWithHubWhen: the request spans more than measured CSS extraction, such as redesign, critique, or new visual-system invention

description: Motion design spec: animation, transitions, micro-interactions, reduced motion. sk-design motion mode.

userIntent.job: I want to design purposeful animation, transitions, or reduced-motion behavior for a component or state.

accepts: a component or state transition plus an optional animation library hint
returns: a motion plan with purpose, timing, easing, interaction states, performance notes, and reduced-motion behavior

examples.returnsArtifact: a motion plan with purpose, timing, easing, interaction states, performance notes, and reduced-motion behavior

choreography.action: load the parent hub routing table and shared references

choose a private procedure card only when its trigger matches (interaction-states-pass.md for hover/active/focus/disabled/loading/selected/navigation/form/custom-widget interaction-state work), or ../shared/procedures/polish-gate-orchestration.md for final polish spanning multiple design dimensions; cite the selected card's relative path in the plan or proof line, or state 'Procedure applied: none - baseline motion workflow' if no card matches
load mode references and assets as the work requires, then apply the motion workflow to $ARGUMENTS
prepare implementation handoff only when accepted design output moves to code

nextOptions.when: motion choices change or depend on the overall interface direction

handoff.handoffReason: recommend-only; the user or the sk-design hub chooses the next step, never an automatic chain

registerPolicy.askWhen: the register cannot be resolved from the flag, a declared field, the task cue, or the surface, or the surface is genuinely mixed across Brand and Product so the dials would diverge

deferToHubWhen: the request is primarily static visual-system design, interface direction, or measured CSS extraction

preconditions.requiredInputKind: a component or state transition to animate, plus an optional animation library
preconditions.missingInputQuestion: Which component or state transition should the motion describe, and which library?
preconditions.cannotRunWhen: no component or state transition is named to animate
preconditions.escalateIf: the motion depends on an interface direction that has not been decided yet
preconditions.routeInstead: the request is static visual-system design, interface direction, or measured CSS extraction

discriminator.whenToUse: Use this command when the request is to design purposeful animation, transitions, or reduced-motion behavior.

preferSiblingWhen.when: Prefer interface when the request is to invent the full visual direction or interface concept first.
Prefer md-generator when the request is to capture measured CSS or tokens from a live site.

preferSiblingWhen.sibling: design-mcp-open-design (no standalone command; reached via the sk-design hub paired with a design mode)
preferSiblingWhen.when: Prefer design-mcp-open-design when the request is to wire, read, or drive Open Design's MCP server rather than design animation or motion behavior.

discriminator.pairWithHubWhen: the request is primarily static visual-system design, interface direction, or measured CSS extraction
